title: Nested PF-E004 fusion and disagreement evidence
hypothesis: Strictly nested placement of the E005 PF correction around the deployment-ready E004 geometry-prefix path can retain complementary GR evidence while removing the standalone PF p90 and subgroup regressions.

legal_inputs: inner-training hidden TVT used only to fit the inner fusion decision
forbidden_inputs: outer-validation hidden TVT in E004 fitting, weight fitting, routing, or reliability calibration
E005 observed 50/50 diagnostic result as a validated selector
training-only formation surfaces or typewell Geology
design.nested_validation: For each of 25 outer E001 cells, the held-out fold is absent from every E004 inner fit and from all weight/routing targets. The remaining four original fold labels form four inner OOF groups.
design.promotion: A legal nested candidate must gain at least 0.05 RMSE over E004 and 0.45 over last-known, win at least four of five maps and 17 of 25 outer cells, satisfy p90 and worst-5% limits, improve every nested spatial and typewell group, pass special-slice, shuffled-evidence, stability, runtime, memory, identity, and reproduction controls, and use nonzero PF contribution consistently.
design.deployment: Packaging and private internet-disabled Kaggle parity are authorized only after all statistical gates pass. Promotion does not itself authorize a leaderboard submission.
